bib.title: Seamless: Multilingual Expressive and Streaming Speech Translation

read.skipped: Per-language result tables (Tables 1, 61-75, 78-80) skimmed, not read cell by cell; reference list skimmed.

question: Can one family of models translate speech across many languages while preserving vocal style and prosody, and while streaming with low latency?
contributions: SeamlessM4T v2 with UnitY2, w2v-BERT 2.0 and expanded SeamlessAlign (76 languages)
Red teaming, MuTox, MinTox, SeamlessWM watermarking, metrics (AutoPCP, rhythm toolkit)

method.summary: SeamlessM4T v2 is a 2.3B multitask S2ST model with a w2v-BERT 2.0 encoder, NLLB text model and non-autoregressive T2U decoder. SeamlessExpressive adds a Prosody UnitY2 and a PRETSSEL expressive acoustic model; SeamlessStreaming fine-tunes v2 with EMMA monotonic attention in two stages; Seamless combines streaming with PRETSSEL.
method.task: multilingual speech-to-speech and speech-to-text translation, expressive and streaming

datasets.name: SeamlessAlign (expanded)
datasets.size: 114,800 additional hours, 76 languages; 3.9M hours raw audio
datasets.source: mined with SONAR, margin threshold 1.15, k=16, FAISS, Silero VAD
datasets.preprocessing: filtering rules incl. toxicity imbalance threshold 1, length 0.1-50 s, text <=250 subwords

models.name: SeamlessM4T v2
models.architecture: Multitask-UnitY2: w2v-BERT 2.0 Conformer encoder, NLLB text enc/dec, NAR T2U

models.name: PRETSSEL
models.architecture: textless FastSpeech2-like acoustic model, ECAPA-TDNN 512-dim expressivity encoder, FiLM, Gaussian upsampler, HiFi-GAN mel vocoder

training.objective: multitask S2TT/T2TT/ASR with token-level knowledge distillation; T2U with CTC forward-sum and GLAT; EMMA latency and variance losses for streaming
training.optimizer: Adam (watermark, MuTox); not stated for the main models
training.batch_size: Prosody UnitY2 302k tokens (360k for E2M/M2M); SeamlessWM 32; HiFi-GAN 16
training.steps: X2T 200K updates (100K per stage); PRETSSEL 500k iterations; Prosody UnitY2 max 600k steps; SeamlessWM 400k steps

other.streaming_stages: stage 1 simultaneous text decoder with encoder frozen; stage 2 T2U only

inference.decoding: beam search; ASR-BLEU scored with Whisper-Large greedy; streaming via SimulEval

metrics.name: BLEU / chrF / ASR-BLEU
metrics.definition: text or ASR-transcribed speech output vs reference

metrics.name: AutoPCP
metrics.definition: 3-layer net on XLS-R layer 9, regression plus contrastive

eval.protocol: automatic plus human (PCP 5 annotators, MOS 3); PCP eng-X not completed

availability.data: aligned data metadata and code released

limits: Human PCP eng-X evaluation incomplete; X-eng PCP excludes cmn and fra.
Expressive models trained without the semantic and prosodic data filtering due to time limit.
PRETSSEL raises expressivity but lowers MOS sound quality and clarity; joint training lowers VSim and AutoPCP.
Streaming loses 10-31% BLEU against offline, most in zero-shot languages; over-generation there.
Expressive covers only 5 non-English languages; Seamless drops phrase-level rate and pause preservation.
Watermarked released models may differ slightly from reported results.
Research-only models, not for long-form use.
Gender overgeneralization not improved over v1; T2TT chrF drops 1.6 vs v1.
Red-team prompts differed between models, so toxicity results are not directly comparable.
Batch size, learning rate and hardware for the main M4T v2 and streaming training, and seeds, are not stated. The PDF gives no arXiv id.
